sources.finding: Engine inspection detail depends on build-time profiling verbosity. Explicit tensor-debug marking can inhibit fusion; marking all unfused tensors is documented to preserve fusion. Runtime listeners receive tensor data and require correct stream synchronization; some unfused tensors cannot be marked.
